ImageDescription.value: Drawing of the upper-right part of the victory stele of pharaoh Piye, depicting Piye being tributed by four Nile Delta rulers: Nimlot (holding an horse) and his queen (before him), Osorkon IV, Iuput II and Peftjauawybast [see note for details]. Original stele in granite, found at Jebel Barkal and datable to the reign of Piye, 25th dynasty, now in the Cairo Museum.
